summary: stui writes one line to exits.log each time it ends (when, how long it ran and why: quit, a signal, the terminal closing, an error with its text, or a panic), notes in it when its own program is replaced on disk while it runs (a deploy that can make the system stop it, and says so on screen), and writes slow.log when a draw or a turn of its loop is slow with kinds and counts of what was on screen, so a crash or a slow stretch can be explained afterwards

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: No schema, operation or contract digest change. stui only.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change.

recovery.detail: exits.log and slow.log are in the cache directory beside the run files, each bounded to 100 KB, and deleting them loses only history.
